action.command:
cd /tmp && rm -f op_cj.txt
PAGE=$(curl -s -c op_cj.txt http://localhost:8080/login)
TOKEN=$(echo "$PAGE" | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"$//')
echo "token_len=${#TOKEN}"
curl -s -b op_cj.txt -c op_cj.txt -o /dev/null -w 'POST /login: HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST http://localhost:8080/login \
  -H 'Origin: http://localhost:8080' -H 'Referer: http://localhost:8080/login' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' \
  --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "login=admin" \
  --data-urlencode "password=admin"
echo "--- follow session ---"
curl -s -b op_cj.txt -c op_cj.txt -o /dev/null -w 'GET /projects (authed): HTTP %{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n' -L http://localhost:8080/projects
